name: Vulgar Reverie
source:
[i]"Love conquers all"
A simple saying. If two people love each other, any obstacle can be overcome. But the question is...
How far would you both be willing to go for the sake of that love?[/i]

Vulgar Reverie is a NETORASE adult visual novel game where your wife is an ex-mafia family member who ran away with you when you confessed your love for her!

That means that, over the years, you've always been looking over your shoulder, running from your troubles and constantly living in fear of getting caught by the past she left behind.

All you've ever wanted was to be able to live your life with the one you love in peace. But as you continued to think and think, your mind warped your emotions into something else... Where the scenarios you always imagined ended up turning sexual... With you not really involved. That twisted pleasure you felt is crazy, wrong and something you can never tell your wife...

Right?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/saxonado/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
[i]“爱可以战胜一切”
简单的一句话。如果两个人彼此相爱，任何障碍都可以克服。但问题是…
为了这份爱你们愿意走多远？[/i]

Vulgar Reverie是一款NETORASE成人视觉小说游戏，在游戏中，你的妻子是一位前黑手党家庭成员，当你向她表白你对她的爱时，她就和你私奔了！

这意味着，多年来，你总是提心吊胆，逃避麻烦，并不断生活在担心被她留下的过去所抓住的恐惧之中。

你所想要的只是能够与你所爱的人平静地生活。但当你继续思考和思考时，你的思想将你的情绪扭曲成其他东西……你一直想象的场景最终变成了性……而你并没有真正参与其中。你感受到的那种扭曲的快乐是疯狂的、错误的，而且你永远无法告诉你的妻子……

对吗？
